title: Minimum Test Bays
description:
Your team runs hardware-in-the-loop tests, and every test needs a bay for its whole duration. Each booking is a half-open interval [start, end): the bay is busy from start up to, but not including, end. A test that starts exactly when another ends can reuse the same bay.

Given the list of bookings, return the minimum number of bays needed to run every test without conflicts. Return 0 if there are no bookings.

Constraints:
- 0 <= bookings.length <= 10^4
- 0 <= start < end <= 10^6
- bookings are not sorted
